# Third-party components

`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` lists every third-party component the app and the
desktop installers carry (npm packages, Rust crates, the Python packages and
runtime frozen into the sidecar, and the Pretendard font, whose license is
`Pretendard-OFL.txt`) with its license text. It is generated by
`scripts/third_party_notices.py`, and the release workflow regenerates it on
each platform before the installers are built.
